name: Magical Shooter Luna ~Juu to Shokushu to Sukumizu to~
original_name: マジカル・シューター ルナ～銃と触手とスク水と～
source:
"Hunt the monsters"
All they can remember is that phrase.
Two girls, Luna and Misa, have lost all other memory. They were searching for their memory while hunting for the monsters as told.
And finally, they got a clue; they arrived at an abandoned mansion in a remote area.
Luna recognized the mansion, and the two stepped inside the castle full of monsters...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE075041.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
“猎杀魔物。”

她们只记得这句话。

露娜与美沙失去了除此之外的一切记忆。遵照那句话猎杀魔物的同时，两名少女也在不断寻找自己的过去。终于，她们得到一条线索，来到偏僻地区的一座废弃宅邸。

露娜认出了这座宅邸。两人随即踏入这座遍布魔物的城堡……
